summary: ACCEPT V3-08 repair cycle 35694131180. Objective: REPAIR the trusted finalizer failure from Actions run 35692317866 (Android API 35 install/launch/golden-path E2E blocker) while preserving all accepted criteria. The candidate delta is exactly two files: scripts/e2e-android.js (+12/-16) and __tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts (+5/-5). The repair raises the Demarrer waitFor timeout from 1080s to 1260s. Root cause verified against the accepted baseline code and the previous audit's flagged weakness: on degraded API 35 x86_64 emulators each uiautomator dump takes 30-60s; the stuck-app detector fires only after COLD_START_GRACE_MS (450s) plus STUCK_APP_THRESHOLD (8) consecutive empty dumps, i.e. 450 + 8x60 = 930s in the worst case. The 1080s timeout (accepted in cycle 35686566515) left a recovery budget of only 1080 - 930 - 17 (force-stop + monkey) = 133s for the relaunched app's cold start, below the documented 240s first-cold-start worst case, so the relaunched app could not appear before the timeout fired — consistent with the finalizer E2E failure in run 35692317866. The 1260s timeout covers the full worst case: 930s (stuck detection) + 17s (force-stop + monkey relaunch) + 240s (relaunch cold start) + 60s (dump to detect Demarrer) = 1247s < 1260s, leaving 73s headroom, and fits within the GitHub Actions default step timeout (360 min). Independent timing verification against the actual script constants confirms the math. The contract test is updated consistently (expects waitFor('Demarrer', 1260000, { graceMs: COLD_START_GRACE_MS })) and passes 24/24. Trusted verification exit code 0: typecheck clean, 454 tests/22 suites pass, privacy release contract OK (71 tests), cost regression gate OK (21 tests), expo export android OK, prebuild OK, gradlew :app:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 19m14s. Independent checks reproduce: node --check OK, finalizer-wrapper contract tests 24/24 pass, timing math verified. No product code changed: src/, app/, governance, directives, docs, workflows byte-identical to the pristine accepted tree. No V3-01..V3-07 invariant regressed. No must-fix remains.
